Positivity forces N<1 almost surely and therefore m<1/(1+h). Rewriting the second regression gives the conditional harmonic identity at N_*=mh/(1-m); expanding (Y-Y_*)^2/Y yields exactly E[N|P]-N_*=E[(N-N_*)^2/(h+N)|P]. The predator speed factorization gives the coefficient (1-m)^(-2). Conditional orthogonality proves both variance-speed identities. Vanishing defect forces N=N_* and invariance then P=P_*, so strictness is correctly classified.
